title: specanchor rule v1
description: A single business rule extracted from a legacy system. Invariants enforced by the producing skill: no rule without at least one resolvable source_ref; confidence 'evidenced' only when evidence names a test that actually ran and passed.

rule_id.description: Stable identity. Travels to spec, test, commit. Immutable, never reused.

version.description: Bumped when the rule's meaning changes.

statement.description: One sentence, domain language, no code identifiers. Checked against the ledger's aliases_in_code by the statement-quality gate.

source_ref.description: Where the rule lives in the legacy system. A rule without a resolvable source_ref is rejected, not flagged.

confidence.description: evidenced = a characterization test proved it against the running legacy system.

evidence.description: test_id (CHAR-nnnn) that proves the rule, or the reason it could not be proven.

open_questions.description: What a domain expert must answer. Each independently closable. The most valuable field in the artefact — never cleaned up.

disposition.description: Set by a human in the validation workshop, never by a tool.

decided_by.description: Person; required when disposition is set.

supersedes.description: Set when this rule replaces another.
